title: Women Airforce Service Pilots (WASP)
summary: About 1,074 women pilots ferried 12,652 aircraft, towed targets and carried cargo for the US Army Air Forces; 38 died in service.
why: Freed male pilots for combat in the Second World War.

unsung.contribution: Flew over 60 million miles ferrying and testing military aircraft for the US Army Air Forces.
unsung.recognition: As civilians they got no military benefits and their records stayed secret; veteran status came in 1977, a Gold Medal in 2009.
